decks.notes: This deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Tower) to generate a large amount of mana, which is used to control the game by countering spells, bouncing threats, and ultimately locking down the opponent's resources. It utilizes various control elements such as counterspells, removal, and powerful threats like Ugin, the Spirit Dragon to take over the game and ultimately win through card advantage and superior board presence. Additionally, it has the potential to tutor for specific artifacts using Trinket Mage and Treasure Mage to further its game plan.

The deck focuses on efficient early-game aggression and disruption, using cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Blood Moon to control the board while deploying threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker. The deck also includes removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push to deal with opposing threats. With a mix of hand disruption, removal, and powerful creatures, the deck aims to apply pressure quickly and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure a fast victory.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent quickly with a swarm of low-cost artifact creatures while using cards like Cranial Plating and Shadowspear to boost their power. The deck also utilizes cards like Thoughtcast and Urza's Saga to draw more cards and generate additional resources. The inclusion of artifact lands and mana-generating artifacts helps to ensure a smooth mana curve and board presence. The goal is to establish a strong board presence early on and pressure the opponent before they can effectively respond.

This deck utilizes the Indomitable Creativity card to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and create a combo with Dwarven Mine tokens. It includes versatile spells like Lightning Bolt, Prismari Command, and Prismatic Ending for removal and control. Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six provide additional utility and support. The deck aims to be creative in its strategy and wins through explosive plays using cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Leyline Binding. It also includes lands like Ketria Triome and Boseiju, Who Endures for added consistency and protection.

This deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity and Transmogrify to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty early in the game. Teferi, Time Raveler provides disruption and protection while Wrenn and Six helps with consistent land drops. The deck also includes spells like Persist and Leyline Binding to support the combo strategy. The mix of removal spells like Lightning Bolt and counterspells like Spell Pierce helps to control the game and protect the combo. The deck aims to be creative in its approach to winning the game quickly and decisively.

The key concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy, using low-cost creatures and disruptive spells to establish board control quickly. By playing multiple creatures each turn and leveraging the abilities of cards like Champion of the Parish and Thalia's Lieutenant, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and force the opponent to react defensively. The inclusion of protection spells like Shining Shoal and Solitude helps to protect key creatures and maintain tempo on the battlefield, ultimately leading to a swift victory.

The deck focuses on using Cascade spells to quickly and efficiently play out threats and disrupt the opponent. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck can cascade into powerful cards like Crashing Footfalls and Endurance. The aim is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy, while also controlling the game with cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Force of Negation. The deck also includes land options like Gemstone Caverns and fetch lands to ensure consistent mana base.

This deck focuses on fast and aggressive gameplay by utilizing efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, along with burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Spell Snare and Counterspell to control the game and protect its threats. With the ability to generate card advantage through cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration, this deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain tempo throughout the game.

This deck focuses on using disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the opponent's resources, while also utilizing aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief to apply pressure to the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Blood Moon and Terminate to deal with problematic permanents on the opponent's side of the battlefield. Overall, the key strategy is to combine aggressive creatures with disruptive spells to maintain board control and pressure the opponent's life total.

The main concept of this deck revolves around quickly deploying low-cost threats such as Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler to apply pressure early on. The deck also utilizes disruptive spells like Counterspell and Unholy Heat to control the board and protect its creatures. Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble help to filter through the deck and keep the hand stocked with options. The inclusion of Murktide Regent adds a powerful finisher that can quickly close out games. Overall, this UR Aggro deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with efficient threats and disruption.

This deck focuses on using aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Territorial Kavu to quickly pressure the opponent while utilizing powerful removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Tribal Flames to control the board. The deck also utilizes the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring to provide additional mana fixing and utility. With a strong mana base and a mix of efficient threats and answers, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive game plan.

The deck focuses on using Underworld Breach to combo off by casting spells from the graveyard multiple times in a turn. It also utilizes efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler to apply pressure and generate card advantage.  The inclusion of cards like Remand, Spell Pierce, and Lightning Bolt help control the game while setting up the combo. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of spells and creatures.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the "Hammer Time" combo by using Puresteel Paladin and Stoneforge Mystic to equip Colossus Hammer onto a creature, creating a powerful threat with trample and double strike. The deck also includes various protection spells like Spell Pierce, Giver of Runes, and Sigarda's Aid to ensure the combo can't be disrupted easily. Urza's Saga is included as a versatile tutor card to find key pieces of the combo. The strategy revolves around quickly assembling the combo and overwhelming the opponent with a massive, evasive threat.

This Merfolk deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with creatures like Lord of Atlantis and Master of the Pearl Trident, while disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Merfolk Trickster and Force of Negation. The deck also uses Aether Vial to cheat creatures into play and Cavern of Souls to make Merfolk spells uncounterable. Spreading Seas can disrupt the opponent's mana base while Tide Shaper and Vodalian Hexcatcher provide additional support and utility. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast, synergistic Merfolk tribal strategy.

This deck revolves around using Indomitable Creativity to cheat powerful creatures into play, such as Archon of Cruelty, by sacrificing tokens created by Dwarven Mine. It also uses Teferi, Time Raveler to disrupt opponents and protect its combo, while utilizing Wrenn and Six for extra land recursion. The deck includes a few counterspells and removal spells to control the board, as well as card draw and utility spells like Prismari Command. The overall strategy is to surprise opponents with unexpected plays and overwhelming threats.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures such as Archon of Cruelty and combo pieces like Persist. The deck also utilizes Teferi, Time Raveler to protect its combo pieces and disrupt opposing strategies. The combination of Prismari Command and Leyline Binding helps control the board while Wrenn and Six provide value and consistency. The inclusion of cards like Lightning Bolt and Spell Pierce allow for interaction with the opponent and the mana base is built around fetch lands to ensure consistency in casting spells.
